# OWOX

> > OWOX is a self-service analytics platform that helps organizations build data marts and integrate multi-source business data into cloud data warehouses.

OWOX provides a comprehensive data integration and analytics solution enabling teams to collect, structure, and analyze data from advertising platforms, business applications, and cloud data warehouses. The platform supports 150+ connectors and integrates with major data warehouse solutions including BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, Athena, and Databricks.

## Core Platform

- [OWOX Data Marts — Build a Self-Service Analytics System](https://www.owox.com): OWOX Data Marts homepage: self-service analytics platform for data warehouses
- [Data Mart Management](https://www.owox.com/product-features/data-mart-management): Structure your data once and reuse it everywhere with reusable data structures for BigQuery, Snowflake, and other warehouses
- [Data Sources](https://www.owox.com/product-features/data-sources): Collect and blend data from business apps and advertising platforms into your data warehouse
- [Data Storages](https://www.owox.com/product-features/data-storages): Support for BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, Athena, and Databricks cloud data warehouses

## Advertising Data Connectors

- [Google Ads Integration](https://www.owox.com/data-sources/google-ads): Integrate Google Ads data with BigQuery, Snowflake, and other data destinations
- [Facebook Ads Integration](https://www.owox.com/data-sources/facebook-ads): Integrate Facebook Ads data with BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, and other warehouses
- [LinkedIn Ads Integration](https://www.owox.com/data-sources/linkedin-ads): Integrate LinkedIn Ads data with BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, and other platforms
- [TikTok Ads Integration](https://www.owox.com/data-sources/tik-tok): Integrate TikTok Ads data with BigQuery, Snowflake, and other data destinations
- [Reddit Integration](https://www.owox.com/data-sources/reddit): Integrate Reddit data with BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, and other warehouses
- [Free Connectors Library](https://www.owox.com/connectors): Access OWOX's free connector library for Facebook, Google, LinkedIn, Microsoft, and other ad platforms

## Data Warehouse Destinations

- [Google BigQuery](https://www.owox.com/data-destination/google-bigquery): Connect your business data to Google BigQuery for scalable analytics
- [Snowflake](https://www.owox.com/data-destination/snowflake): Build scalable analytics-ready data marts on Snowflake
- [Amazon Redshift](https://www.owox.com/data-destination/aws-redshift): Collect and model business data in Amazon Redshift for analytics
- [Amazon Athena](https://www.owox.com/data-destination/aws-athena): Run serverless analytics on Amazon S3 with OWOX integration
- [Databricks](https://www.owox.com/data-destination/databricks): Build analytics-ready data marts on Databricks Delta Lake

## Visualization & Reporting

- [Google Sheets](https://www.owox.com/data-destination/google-sheets): Free connector for integrating data warehouse data with Google Sheets
- [Looker Studio](https://www.owox.com/data-destination/looker-studio): Free connector for data visualization and reporting with Looker Studio
